text: Housecarl Larsstar is a Nord guarding the entrance to the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.
Housecarl Nelmryn is a Nord guarding the entrance to the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm.
Hrarlief is a Nord found inside Eiman and Rolunda's House in Bleakrock Village. She has no unique dialogue.
Hrordulf is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Ibomez the Flesh Sculptor is a Xivkyn boss found in Imperial City Prison . He may drop the Toxic Cleaver, part of the Sheer Venom set.
Ice-Biter Savage is a goblin in that is a member of the Ice-Biter Tribe.
Ice-Biter Butcher is a goblin in that is a member of the Ice-Biter Tribe.
Ice-Biter Shaman is a goblin in that is a member of the Ice-Biter Tribe.

Huntmaster Sorim-Nakar is a Dunmer residing in Ald'ruhn, Vvardenfell. He is the huntmaster of the Erabenimsun Tribe and, after completion of the quest "Ashlander Relations," offers the Vestige challenges to hunt down and kill various creatures in Vvardenfell.
Athyn Rotheran is an Ashlander first encountered in an Ashlander camp near Molag Mar during "An Armiger's Duty."
Huma al-Hallin's is a Redguard residing in Martyr's Crossing. She cannot be interacted with.

Hursh is a deceased Khajiit found the caves to the west of Greenleaf Farm. According to Kinaro, when Euraxia's soldiers chased the Khajiit out of the fields and started digging, Hursh fought back with a rock and was shot and killed by an arrow. He is Tsazii's brother.
Hurzhar is a Khajiit residing in Rimmen. He can be found washing clothes in the public square.

I'ric Harad Egun, also called I'ric, and referred as the ArchMagister, is a character in . He is referenced throughout the King Edward series. He was and Altmer and the Archmagister of the Crystal Tower sometime in the First Era. He took Moraelyn under his wing and inducted him into the Crystal Tower.
Humble Zaham is a Dagi Khajiit fence residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr.
Hurgedor is a Bosmer beggar residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr.
Hyg is a Nord found near the Western Skyrim Docks outside of Solitude.
Huzodir is a Redguard employee of Kasalla who serves as a sentry for her warehouse.
Hyenril is a Bosmer in that is a part of the Arms of Chaos Creation Club content.
Hugin Ice-Shaper is a deceased Nord in that is a part of the Nordic Jewelry Creation Club content.
Hrotti Blackblade was an Atmoran warrior and a member of the Five Hundred Companions. She is the ancestor of Aela the Huntress.
Im-Kilaya is an Argonian who lives in Ebonheart, Morrowind. He is the leader and consul of the Argonian Mission, where he can be found.
Ienasa Radas is a Dunmer Commoner residing in Vos, on the eastern coast of Vvardenfell. She can be found near her farmhouse.

Ida Vlinorman is an Imperial and an Apprentice Acrobatics trainer. She has a house in the Elven Gardens District. She keeps her collection of handbills in her basement there. She likes to travel to Chorrol and is a gambler at the Imperial City Arena. She also climbs chapels in the Elven Gardens District and the Talos Plaza District. She will not say it, but she is a so-called "associate" to Marinus Catiotus.
Idrolian is a Bosmer Battlemage and criminal hiding in Hrota Cave, located north of Anvil.
Idonea Munia is an Imperial healer and trader who has a shop in the Upper Waistworks in the Foreign Quarter of Vivec City.
Ildogesto is an Imperial vampire who resides in Galom Daeus. He is a member of the Berne Vampire Clan.
Idlami is a Nord Barbarian, and worshipper of Molag Bal, residing in Yansirramus.

Idgrod the Younger is a Nord who resides in Morthal. She is the only daughter of Jarl Idgrod Ravencrone and Aslfur of Morthal and cares for her younger sickly brother, Joric. She is located in or around Highmoon Hall in Morthal.
Illdi is a Nord bard who studies at the Bards College in Solitude.

Iddra is a Nord innkeeper of Braidwood Inn found in Kynesgrove. She offers rooms for rent (10) and sells different kinds of food. She is the wife of Kjeld, and the mother of Kjeld the Younger and a girl named Froa.

Ilas-Tei is a deceased Argonian apprentice mage from the College of Winterhold in . He was one of the missing students that Phinis Gestor will tell the Dragonborn of. He died practicing a Calm spell on skeevers, evidently with little success. Two Scrolls of Calm and a Scroll of Fury can be found nearby. The Scroll of Fury is lying right next to him with the Scroll of Calm on a nearby crate.

Ida Ottus is an Imperial commoner living in the Temple District of the Imperial City. Her parents are Hastrel Ottus and Alessia Ottus. Both her and her parents are devout temple worshippers, she also occasionally makes trips to Anvil and ends up staying at The Flowing Bowl. Whilst in Anvil, she will take a visit to the Chapel of Dibella. Although it is suggested that she is far more interested in Mara.
Ilmeni Dren is a Dunmer Noble and member of House Hlaalu, who resides in St. Delyn Canal South-One.
Idronea Sadri is a Dunmer assassin and slaver residing in the cave of Assarnud.

Idros Givyn is a Dunmer Crusader who resides in Venim Manor's Private Quarters in Ald'ruhn. He is a Redoran Guard protecting the manor of Bolvyn Venim. Unlike most Redoran Guards, he wears Dwemer armor instead of the normal bonemold armor.

Idroso Vendu is a Dunmer Mage. She lives in the Temporary Telvanni Housing in the Telvanni Plaza of Vivec City. As her location suggests, she is a member of House Telvanni; her rank is Oathman. She, along with another resident of the housing, has a Morag Tong writ targeting her.
Ienas Nadus is a Dunmer Battlemage and oathman for House Redoran who resides in Indarys Manor.
Ienase Relnim is a Dunmer Noble who may be found in St. Olms Plaza in Vivec City. Ienase's residence can be found in Vivec City, St. Olms Upper North-Two.
Ienaso Adren is a Dunmer warrior and worshipper of Mehrunes Dagon residing in Ebernanit in the Ashlands.
Ildos Rothren is a Dunmer agent and a member of a bandit gang that has occupied the Dunmer stronghold Andasreth. He can be found on the lower level and is hostile.
Ilen Faveran is a Dunmer enchanter who resides in the Balmora Temple. He is an Initiate-ranked member of the Tribunal Temple who offers services to the public.
Ilet Tistar is a Dunmer warrior and member of the Tribunal Temple who resides in the Ministry of Truth.
Ilmyna Romoren is a Dunmer Barbarian residing in a cave known as Milk in the West Gash region of Morrowind.

Ilden Mirel is a Redguard Warrior and member of the Fighters Guild. He can be found in Vivec City, in the Ministry of Truth floating fortress. After speaking with him, he reveals that he is in the prison "for some sort of blasphemy or something." Upon further questioning about "blasphemy," he will say "It was nothing, really. Just regular barracks talk. But there was a lady present and this Redoran lord got up on his hind legs and was gonna slit me like a sturgeon. Better this way. Damn sight better."
Ignatius Flaccus is an Imperial enchanter living in his house in Godsreach, Mournhold.
Ilnori Faustus is an Imperial crusader who lives in Godsreach and works in the Craftsmen's Hall. He is very taken by himself and disapproves of being a blacksmith apprentice.
Ilring is a Bosmer ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed, and the ghosts have returned to the temple. He is the lover of Heragaeth.
Idhassi is a Khajiit slave who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
Ilekama is a Khajiit patron of the Outside Inn in Elden Root.
Ilmure is an Altmer armorer residing in the city of Marbruk, Greenshade. He can be found at his stall, Ilmure's Imported Steel, selling his wares.
Ikran is a Redguard residing in the Northern High Rock Gate.
Ildani is a Khajiit of the Baandari. She is smuggling and selling skooma in Sentinel.
Ilem Hlaalu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu residing inside the Sadri House in Narsis.
Ilmeni Arelas is a Dunmer quartermaster of the Undaunted. She is found at their enclave just outside the city of Mournhold.
Idesa the Trim is a Nord clothier. She works and sells her wares at The Anvil & Pauldron in Windhelm.
Idona Strongsword is a Nord patron of The Sober Nord Tavern in Windhelm.
Ig the Impetuous is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm, seen near The Adept's Retreat. She listens to Fargurd. She is a celebrant of the Konunleikar. She has no unique dialogue.
Idela is a Nord residing in Port Hunding who can be found gambling on back alley Mudcrab fights.
Idrenia is a Dunmer outlaw and member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Alten Corimont.
Iduthal is a Khajiit brewer. He works at the Overlook Inn in Firsthold.
Ifriz the Unraveler is a powerful Dremora mage found at the Tower of Lies.
Igeford is a Nord patron of The Shining Star in the Hollow City.
Ignace is a Breton beggar found sleeping on the southern docks of Daggerfall.
Ignobert Ervine is a Breton refugee from Crestshade who disappeared mysteriously from Camp Tamrith during the night.
Iirond is a Bosmer member of the Blacksap Rebellion in Cormount.
Ilambris-Athor is a powerful Xivilai found in Crypt of Hearts in Rivenspire.
Ilambris-Zaven is a Xivilai found in Crypt of Hearts I in Rivenspire.
Ilanadzeh is a Khajiit fence part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Mournhold.
Ilara is a Khajiit student found at the College of Aldmeri Propriety.
Ildrasai-daro is a young Dunmer found at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance.
Ilg is an Orsimer residing in the city of Shornhelm, Rivenspire.
Ilmaha at-Amil is a Redguard part of the Sentinel City Guard. She is an informer of Prince Azah.
Ilthag Ironblood is an Orsimer member of the Iron Orcs residing in his stronghold in Craglorn. He lives with his two tamed Welwa, Rahk and Vosh.
Ilwan at-Nazim is a Redguard lieutenant of the Ra Gada who is involved in the attack on Velyn Harbor.
Im-Kajin is an Argonian beggar found sweeping the dirt outside of Daynila's House in Stormhold, Shadowfen.
Imhey is an Argonian who has been infected by Bloodfiends while on her way back to Wittestadr. She is seeking a way to cure her vampirism.
Imadza is a Khajiit patron of The Sleepy Eaglet in Skywatch.
Igmund Garnier is a Breton brewer and member of the Lion Guard. He sells his wares at his stall, the Conqueror's Kitchen, in the Bangkorai Garrison, Bangkorai.
Ilzo is a Breton member of the Lion Guard. He is found at the Bangkorai Garrison.
Ilermarin is a Redguard found in the Hubalajad Palace in the city of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. He can be seen dancing to the music of Dombuza, but is impossible to interact with.
Illia Polus is a traveling Imperial merchant. She is found along the Gold Road.
Ilver Indarys was a member of the Knights of the Thorn in 4E 40. He is most likely a descendant of either Farwil Indarys or Andel Indarys.
Ienasa Telvanni is a Dunmer alchemist working at Alchemical Solutions in the Foundation's Embrace marketplace in Vivec City, Vvardenfell.
Idofrid is a Nord fisherman residing in Windhelm. He is one of the many assassination targets that can be assigned in Eastmarch.
Ignace Geves is a Breton fisher residing in the Brewers and Fishmongers Hall in the Saint Olms Waistworks in Vivec City. He has no unique dialogue.
Ildari Andavel is a Dunmer pilgrim of the Tribunal Temple residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She is located within the Gnisis Temple. She has no unique dialogue.

Iffech is a Khajiiti Sea Captain that appeared in . Captain Iffech first appeared in the Prologue to the story as the Captain of the Wind Oracle. Iffech first felt the sea shutter when Umbriel first appeared out of Oblivion and was very suspicious about how quiet the sea was being afterward. After the sea shifted again and Keem fell from the Crow's Nest, he began to speculate and reminisce on similar events in his lifetime. He braced for impact when the sky turned black and green lightning strike the sky. He knew his and Grayne's lives were over when a large black mass approached them. Both of them died when a strong breeze of foul air enveloped them, and their ship collapsed.
Idera Andrilo is a Dunmer commoner residing in Andrilo's House in Seyda Neen, Vvardenfell. She is the wife of Boryn Andrilo. She has no unique interactions.
Idryn Arys is a character residing in Ald'ruhn, in Vvardenfell.
Idessia Aurunceia is an Imperial commoner found at the Grand Depository in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. She does not have any unique dialogue.

Illia Gabinia is a Breton residing in one of the The Anemone's prison cells. She can be found there during the quest "Prison Break." After being released from the cage she cannot be interacted and will disappear from the game.
Idari Ulessen is a Dunmer found at the southern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Idaug is a Nord warrior of the Fighters Guild residing in the guildhall in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.
Imago Storm is a high-ranking Dremora in who can be found in Havok Wellhead. He is the chief of Clan Dremora.
Idolan Lancaster is a priest during the Imperial Simulacrum, who resides in the Conclave of Baal in Stormhold, Black Marsh. Idolan plays a major role in the main quest of .
Ilmyna Dral is a Dunmer residing in the Gladiator's Quarters outside of Solitude.
Idonea Torquatus is an Imperial warrior residing in the Bog Brokers marketplace at northern Lilmoth. She has no unique dialogue.
Igrit is a character in that is a part of the Bloodchill Manor Creation Club content.
Idros Bereloth is a Dunmer member of House Redoran residing in the Redoran Kinhouse in Balmora. He can only be interacted with during the quest.
Ilaatysar is an Altmer who can be found in the Vault of Moawita chamber of College of Psijics Ruins in Artaeum. He has no unique dialogue.
Imperial Bodyguard is a hostile Imperial encountered in the Time-Lost Throne Room. He has no unique dialogue.

Indaryn is a Dunmer, and head of the Black-Briar Meadery in Riften. Indaryn shows no nervousness about losing his job, and unlike most other workers at the meadery, gives his honest opinion of Maven Black-Briar if asked.
The Imperial Captain is an Imperial member of the Imperial Legion, overseeing the execution of prisoners of war at Helgen before the attack by Alduin.

Imus the Dull is an Imperial commoner and beggar trying to get by in the city of Anvil. He sleeps on his bedroll behind The Flowing Bowl at the dockside every night between 10pm and 6am. He can provide information on how to join the Thieves Guild if his disposition is high enough.
Imperial Jailor is an Imperial guard who can be found in The Bastion in the Imperial City's Prison District.
Imperial Legion Captain is a captain of the Imperial Legion.
Imperial Legion Centurions are Imperial commanders of the Imperial Legion.
Imperial Headsman is a member of the Imperial Legion in Helgen.
Inarala is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Inawyn is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She is found outdoors, leaning against a stone and wood column.
Imtithah is a Redguard residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She is found upstairs, in The Armored Forge. She is the daughter of Sabrilah.
Imzadda is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp, in Alcaire Castle. He is found praying in one of the tents in the camp.
Indilure is an Altmer mystic residing in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost. He can be found at his shop, The Wandering Mystic, selling his wares.
Incunabulist Vicmond is a Breton mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in Kozanset. He can be found at the local guildhall where he sells his wares.
Inaya is a Redguard brewer residing in the city of Hallin's Stand.
In-No-Hurry is an Argonian brewer residing in the Tal'Deic Fortress, Deshaan.
Inare is an Altmer clothier in who sells wares at her tent Snip & Stitch Outfitters in the city of Skywatch.
Indiir is a Bosmer laborer residing in the city of Skywatch.
Imrahasah is a Redguard laborer residing in the town of Dragonstar. He cannot be interacted with.
Imriel is a Bosmer banker at the Vaults of Velyn Harbor in Velyn Harbor.
Ina of the Fangs is a Breton soldier of House Montclair hiding in an abandoned house in Northpoint.
Indalhur is a Khajiit patron of the Market-Side Meadery in Skywatch.
Indanas is a Bosmer of the Driladan Clan found in the Shadows Crawl.
Indel Swollen-Foot is a Bosmer beggar that can be encountered at various locations in Stonefalls.
Indinor is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, Greenshade.
Inawyn Macile is a Breton commoner in who resides in Bleakrock Village on Bleakrock Isle. She has no unique dialogue.
Inalion is an Altmer treasure hunter who can be found, alongside her companion Okulald, digging treasures across Cyrodiil. If one attempts to dig the same mound as them, they will turn hostile.
Impudius Caecus is an Imperial soldier of the Seventh Legion. He is being held captive by Daggerfall Covenant forces after they retake the Bangkorai Garrison.

Indal is a Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is fighting on the frontlines in Cyrodiil. He is the brother of Ehtayah, a moon priestess who resided at the Do'Krin Monastery. She was slain when the Dro-m'Athra stormed the place. In her dying wish, she seeks to pray for her brother's well-being. Once her wish is concluded, Indal will briefly appear in spirit form at the shrine to speak with her sister one last time.
Incarnate Ranso is a Dunmer ghost and failed incarnate of Indoril Nerevar, haunting the Cavern of the Incarnate on Vvardenfell.
Inalz is an Argonian residing in Mother's Den, a sublocation of the Shimmerene Waterworks underneath the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. She has no unique dialogue.
Indalinwe is an Altmer residing in the city of standing in front of Varandia's shop, Abacean Imports, at the Plaza of the Eight in Shimmerene, Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Imrubeth is a redguard residing in Abandoned Tower near the Hollow Waste Dolmen in Alik'r Desert.
Inala is a Redguard who can be found in Lillandril docks in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.

Inalzin is a Khajiit warrior who appears near the Abode of Ignominy in Northern Elsweyr. He can be found next to the Star Haven Wayshrine. After the player starts the quest "An Animal's Grim Abode," he will disappear from that place.
Imperial Champion is a Nord soldier with the Imperial Legion in . He was added as part of the Civil War Champions Creation Club content.

Lord Indoril Nerevar, known formally as Serjo Indoril Nerevar Mora, and alternatively as St. Nerevar the Captain, Nerevar Moon-and-Star, and Godkiller, was a Chimer hero who lived during the First Era. He was a champion of Azura and the first Hortator, or war-leader/champion, of the unified Chimer and Dwemer, following the overthrowing of the Nordic Empire in Resdayn. However, after the discovery that the Dwemer were creating the Numidium, he led his people against them in the War of the First Council. Nerevar died at Red Mountain, though the exact cause is disputed. Later, he became a Saint of the Dunmer's Tribunal Temple. Nerevar played a crucial role in Morrowind's history. The Ashlanders
Iniel is an Altmer mage in the Mages Guild in Sadrith Mora. She is the Guild Guide of the Sadrith Mora branch, and is also not involved in any quests.

Inius Colus is an Imperial crusader who is member of the clergy at the Great Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal and a journeyman Speechcraft trainer. He trains until 6:00 P.M. Inius will replace Gruiand Garrana if she dies. The only main difference is that Inius will not help provide the Master Training reference.

Iniel Sintav is a resident of the Imperial City and leader of the Sintav clan, a respected family of the Imperial City who are rivals of another family clan, the Atius clan, lead by Severius Atius. He has a house in the Elven Gardens District, and has found jobs for his family members nearby. Iniel can be found all around the Imperial City and can be found frequenting in The King and Queen Tavern.
Ingokning is a Nord assassin, and a member of the Imperial Legion. She resides in the city of Ebonheart.
Inge Six Fingers is an Elder Nord member of the Bards College in Solitude.

Ingun Black-Briar is a Nord and a member of Riften's affluent Black-Briar family. With her brother Sibbi, Ingun lives with her father Hemming and mother Maven. Currently, she studies alchemy and is working at Elgrim's Elixirs, where she serves as an apprentice to Elgrim.
Ingjaldr White-Eye was a Nord chieftain sometime in late Merethic Era or early First Era.
Iner Raledran is a Dunmer Crusader who can be found outside the Daedric ruin Ebernanit in the Ashlands. He is hostile to the Nerevarine and attacks on sight.
Inera Faryon is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Inganar is an Altmer assassin and worshipper of Mehrunes Dagon. He resides in the cave of Ularradallaku.
Ingjard is a Nord warrior and member of the Dawnguard who can be used as a follower. She appears at Fort Dawnguard and can only be recruited after the quest "Prophet."
Ingrid is a Nord who can be found in Helgen moments before it is attacked by Alduin.
Inee is an Argonian Slave found in the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora.
Ingmar is a Nord warrior found waiting outside of Valbrandr Barrow for help in the slaying of a beast, which he feels will make him a true Skaal.
Inisashu-jo is a Khajiit priest who can be found at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance.
Initiate Mathilde is a Breton and a newly inducted member of the Beldama Wyrd. She is found at their camp in the Vale of the Guardians.
Initiate Gine is a Breton member of the Beldama Wyrd who resides in the Vale of the Guardians in Glenumbra.
Initiate Nyna is a Breton and a newly inducted member of the Beldama Wyrd. She is found at their camp in the Vale of the Guardians.
Initiate Faliara is a Redguard initiate in the Vale of the Guardians in Glenumbra.
Initiate Lamur is an Orsimer initiate in the Vale of the Guardians in Glenumbra.
Initiate Delighre is a Breton merchant and a newly inducted member of the Beldama Wyrd. She sells her wares at their camp in the Vale of the Guardians.
Initiate Raelyn is a Breton and a newly inducted member of the Beldama Wyrd. She is found at their camp in the Vale of the Guardians.
Initiate Aurelie is a Breton and a newly inducted member of the Beldama Wyrd. She is found at their camp in the Vale of the Guardians.
Initiate Celence is a Breton and a newly inducted member of the Beldama Wyrd. She is found at their camp in the Vale of the Guardians.
Inerri is a Khajiit slave who resides in the Vivec, Telvanni Canton.
Ines Derre is a Breton who is found in the Wyrd camp near Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. She is a refugee from Camlorn.
Indithil is a Bosmer brewer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Indralir is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in Grahtwood. He can be found at the Altmer Embassy
Indure is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion who resides in Elden Root, Grahtwood. He is located in the Altmer Embassy within Elden Root.
Ingride Vanne is a Breton residing on Vanne Farm, in the region of Stormhaven. Her parents, Giraud and Anais, handed the farm over to her so she is now the owner of it.

Indrasa Vadryon is a Dunmer residing in Davon's Watch. She is usually found overlooking the stairway that leads to the dockyards of the city. Occasionally Riidras Avani will approach her and they will share a brief conversation.

Inspector Tarma is supervising the Laughing Moons Plantation with his assistant. They are at the plantation to see if there are illegal Skooma productions. He talks to Juranda-ra, the clan mother of the Laughing Moons Plantation.
Indrasi Drim is a Dunmer found inside the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Ineria Hereloth is a Dunmer patron of the Brooding Elf Inn in Quarantine Serk. They have no unique dialogue.
Indrela Falen is a Dunmer patron of the Brooding Elf Inn in Quarantine Serk. They can be found lying on a bed there, and have no unique dialogue.
Instructor Mind-of-Ice is an Argonian residing in the Arch-Mage's Office in Shad Astula.
Instructor Fanvyn is a Dunmer professor residing at the Shad Astula academy, where he is found inside the Arch-Mage's Office.
Instructor Stodlod is a Nord teacher found inside Arch-Mage Valeyn's office in Shad Astula.
Instructor Badami is a Dunmer scholar found in the courtyard of Shad Astula, Deshaan.
Instructor Falan is a Dunmer who resides at the Shad Astula academy. She is usually found in the academy's courtyard.
Instructor Dinaria is a Dunmer professor who resides at the Shad Astula academy. She is usually found near the gateway to the academy speaking to students.
Instructor Elvasia is a Dunmer found in the instruction halls of Shad Astula.
Instructor Arelos is a Dunmer residing inside the northern instructor housing of Shad Astula.
Instructor Mils is a Dunmer found inside the southern instructor housing in Shad Astula.
Instructor Venae is a Dunmer found inside the southern instructor housing of Shad Astula.
Instructor Benaril is a Dunmer residing in the instructor's lounge of Shad Astula.
Instructor Llaarar is a Dunmer found in the instructor's lounge in Shad Astula.
Instructor Peelgah is an Argonian residing in the Instructor's Lounge in Shad Astula.
Instructor Summons-Eyes is an Argonian residing in the Instructor's Lounge in Shad Astula.
Inisa Sarvani is a Dunmer found at the ponds of Shad Astula. She has no unique dialogue.
Instructor Thanusel is a Dunmer found inside the registrar office of Shad Astula. He has no unique dialogue.
Instructor Ninla is a Dunmer found just north of the Shad Astula Wayshrine.
Indrele Berendas is a Dunmer part of the group of outlaws found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Davon's Watch.
Innsold Cold-Moon is a Nord working at her family inn in Windhelm.
Innbild Cold-Moon is a Nord working at her family stables in Windhelm.
Indrathel is a Altmer encountered during the visions taking place on Silatar. Indrathel is the wife of Lorimil, and mother of Aranias.
Indur-sa is a Khajiit part of the trio of bosses found at the Hunter Camp in The Rift.
Inishez is a Khajiit guild trader. He operates his kiosk, Bleakrock Barter, at the Bleakrock Wayshrine.
Inluin is a Bosmer found on the Fisherman's Isle just east of Haven.
Innarrek is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Riften.
Innkeeper Balik is a deceased Breton whose body is located in the city of Northpoint, Rivenspire.
Inue is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild found in the hall of Stormhold.
Investigator Irnand is a wounded Breton and investigator of the Lion Guard found in Wayrest Sewers I.
Investigator Lienne is a Breton investigator of the Lion Guard found in Wayrest Sewers I.
Inulu the Fierce is a powerful Troll found in a cave in The Lion's Den.
Indrenia is a character residing in the town of Alten Corimont.
Indyen is an Altmer member of the Fighters Guild. He can be found at their branch located in Abah's Landing.
Indradriel is a Bosmer residing at the Velmont Estate in Abah's Landing.
Initiate Alana is a Breton and a newly inducted member of the Beldama Wyrd. She is found at their camp in the Vale of the Guardians.
Initiate Josseline is a Breton, the sister of Crafty Lerisa and a member of Society of the Dragon.
Iniel Laftrius is an Imperial member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Marbruk.
Initiate Blatta is an Imperial priestess member of the Society of the Dragon. She is one of the four initiates spreading the word of Akatosh in Kvatch.
Initiate Genele is a Breton priestess member of the Society of the Dragon. She is one of the four initiates spreading the word of Akatosh in Kvatch.
Initiate Perien is a Breton priest and member of the Society of the Dragon. He is one of the four initiates spreading the word of Akatosh in Kvatch.
Initiate Ranius is an Imperial priestess and member of the Society of the Dragon. She is one of the four initiates spreading the word of Akatosh in Kvatch.
The Indolent Farmer is a Nord contractor for the quest "The Dark Brotherhood Forever." He resides in the Vilemyr Inn in Ivarstead.
Innanir is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Investigator Vale is a fictional character appearing in a number of self-titled books in .
Intendant Marall was a member of the Penitus Oculatus during Titus Mede's reign. He was Inspector Colin's superior.
Initiate Favar is a deceased Dunmer Clockwork Apostle whose body can be found in The Shadow Cleft in the Clockwork City.
Initiate Frynga is a Nord member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in Slag Town Outlaws Refuge in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Intovar was one of Chef Toel's underchefs. He was Toel's second in command.
Ineldhel is an Altmer laborer found at the southern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Ingarlas is an Altmer found northeast of Dusk Keep working in the garden near his tent, Summerset.
Instructor Lentidorn is an Altmer who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset.
Instructor Vaerunne is an Altmer who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Instructor Cimerhros is an Altmer who can be found in the Hall of Illumination in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Inila is a Redguard member of The Crowns who can be found inside A'tor's Oasis in the city of Bergama, Alik'r Desert.

Indoril Ancestor Spirit is an ancestor of House Indoril in who is found in the Library of Andule. She blocks the way into the Indoril section of the library, until the player have answered three of her questions correctly. Clues can be found in the nearby book Understanding House Indoril.
Inisargo is a Khajiit residing at in The Stitches, Northern Elsweyr found being intimidated by Gloorz. He has no unique dialogue.
Ingfred the Tall is a Nord residing in Dusktown in Blackreach.

Infernal Performer is a spirit located in Bal Fell on Vvardenfell in . Three of them are encountered during the quest, playing the musical instruments in front of the mind-controlled people. They have no unique dialogue and cannot be interacted with.
Initiate Dreveni is a character located in the Emerald Glyphic Vault, in . They are a member of the Sodality of the Eye tasked with protecting the Emerald Glyphic
Initiate Juste is a character located in the Emerald Glyphic Vault, in . They are a member of the Sodality of the Eye tasked with protecting the Emerald Glyphic
Iratian Albarnian is an Imperial Master-at-Arms and a member of the Imperial Legion living in Caldera.
Irgola is a Redguard merchant living in Caldera. He owns a shop, and will sell various goods.
Irene Metrick is a Breton who can be found in the Market District of the Imperial City. She serves as a Master-level trainer for Blunt weaponry.

Irlav Jarol is an Imperial residing in the Arcane University, where he serves on the Council of Mages as a Master Wizard. He is a researcher specializing in Ayleid history. He authored the book Magic from the Sky.

Irileth is a Dunmer nightblade and a resident of Whiterun in who lives in Dragonsreach. She acts as housecarl to Jarl Balgruuf the Greater, and rarely leaves his side. She assists the Dragonborn in their first battle against the dragon, Mirmulnir. She is encountered again later, as ally or enemy, during the Civil War questline. Irileth is one of four housecarls in the game who is not a Nord. The others are Faleen, the Redguard housecarl of Jarl Igmund of Markarth, Rayya, also a Redguard, who is the housecarl of the Thane of Falkreath Hold, and the fourth is Teeba-Ei, an Argonian who becomes the housecarl to Sorli the Builder if she becomes Jarl of Hjaalmarch during the Civil War.

Iona is a Nord housecarl in The Rift. She is appointed Housecarl of the Dragonborn when they become Thane of the Rift. She waits for the Dragonborn at Honeyside. She does not exist in-game until this happens.
Irnskar Ironhand is a Nord warrior and the Housecarl of Bryling, who lives in Solitude.
Irlof is a Nord pirate in the Blood Horker pirate clan and is working in the crew under captain Stig Salt-Plank. Irlof is blind in his left eye and has a rugged look to his face.
Irgnir is a Nord miner in who resides in Dawnstar. She works in the Iron-Breaker Mine and can be found at Windpeak Inn in the evening, and she lives in her house.
Ioa was the Warlady of Lilmoth in 3E 80. It was uncommon to see a lady take place of a warlord. She is mentioned in The Wolf Queen, Book I.
Iron Golem are elemental creatures encountered in . They are first seen in Labyrinthian, during the quest of the same name.
Irna Maryon is a Dunmer who lives in Tel Aruhn. She offers apothecary services and is an Oathman of House Telvanni.
Irer Nervion is a Dunmer Buoyant Armiger who may be found dead in the dwarven ruins of Falasmaryon.
Inwold is a Breton Sorcerer who resides in the cave of Palansour.
Irien was an Altmer who resided in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She was one of the girls who had fallen for the charming Breton rogue, Jakarn.
Irbran Kirbatha is a Breton smuggler who resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Arkngthand.
Irkki is the Khajiit innkeeper and proprietor of the Screaming Mermaid in Port Hunding.
Iriana is a Dunmer found on the island of Stros M'Kai. She has been kidnapped by the Sea Drakes and brought to their camp near Saintsport.
